# Requirements Checklist: Parameter Exploration & Sharing

**Purpose**: Standard-depth requirements-quality pass across spec.md's
three user stories (sweep, permalink, failure presets) before
`/speckit.tasks` -- validates the requirements themselves (completeness,
clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage), not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist`
command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is a UI-reachability requirement defined for the failure-preset picker (e.g., visible/reachable from every pipeline step), matching User Story 3's Independent Test wording, anywhere in the Functional Requirements section? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 Is a UI-reachability or placement requirement defined for the "Generate permalink" control (which step(s) it must be available from)? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Is a "reset to defaults" requirement defined for a permalink-loaded (non-preset, non-swept) state, or is FR-010's scope limited to preset-loaded/swept states only? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK004 Is there a requirement establishing that the sweep control itself is available in Real Mode, given FR-001 scopes its existence to "(Simulated Mode)" while FR-003 and Acceptance Scenario 4 both assume a Real Mode sweep exists to be confirmed and run? [Gap/Conflict, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: FR-001 rewritten to state the sweep control operates in both modes, Real Mode gated by FR-003.
- [ ] CHK005 Are performance/responsiveness expectations defined for the Simulated Mode sweep (9 synchronous re-computations), given the Independent Test's "no manual re-running required" language implies some responsiveness bar? [Gap, Spec User Story 1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "flat (low-sensitivity) curve" (FR-004) quantified with a specific threshold, or left to implementation discretion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "cost" in FR-003 ("estimated call count and cost are shown") defined -- does it mean a dollar estimate, or is it synonymous with the call-count estimate? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the boundary of "an active, in-progress sweep" (Edge Cases) defined precisely enough to determine whether a Real Mode sweep awaiting cost confirmation (not yet running) counts as "in-progress" for permalink-generation purposes? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Does FR-003/Acceptance Scenario 4's requirement to show an estimated "cost" (dollar figure) conflict with spec 002's own FR-010 precedent, which explicitly scoped Real Mode cost indication to call-count only and deferred dollar-cost estimation to Milestone 4 (roadmap.md)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003 vs. spec 002 §FR-010, roadmap.md Milestone 4] -- **Resolved 2026-08-10**: FR-003, Acceptance Scenario 4, and SC-005 all rewritten to "call count" only, explicitly deferring dollar cost to Milestone 4.
- [ ] CHK010 Is the "chosen output metric" language in User Story 1 and FR-001 consistent with FR-002's specific mention of a single plotted metric, given the sweep is now scoped to one fixed metric only? [Consistency, Spec User Story 1 vs §FR-001/FR-002]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Is SC-001 ("at least one range where the output metric changes meaningfully and at least one range where it stays flat") measurable against a specific, named document/query combination, or does it assume this property holds for an arbitrary/undocumented combination? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK012 Is SC-005's "100% of Real Mode sweeps requiring more than one real API call" measurable as a meaningful boundary case, given the fixed sweep range makes every possible sweep require more than one call by construction (the excluded case can never occur)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for generating a permalink while a failure preset (rather than a sweep) is the most recently loaded state -- does the same document/parameter-exclusion logic apply uniformly? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined for the sweep's behavior if the active query is empty or unset at the moment a sweep is activated? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for what a learner sees if they open a permalink whose `mode=real` parameter is present but the real API calls subsequently fail, distinct from simply not yet being confirmed? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Is behavior defined for a permalink containing a syntactically malformed or out-of-range parameter value (e.g. a chunk size outside the slider's bounds, a threshold outside 0-1)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Is behavior defined for generating a permalink before any query/question has been entered? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK018 Are accessibility requirements for the failure-preset picker and reset-to-defaults control specified with the same rigor as the sweep curve's keyboard-operability requirement added during Clarification, or only the sweep curve's? [Consistency, Coverage, Spec Clarifications]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK019 Is the Assumption that Milestone 2 (Real Mode) is not "strictly required" for this milestone reconciled with FR-003's Real-Mode-specific requirement -- i.e., is FR-003 understood to be inert/out-of-scope entirely when Real Mode isn't present? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions vs §FR-003]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK020 Is a requirement/acceptance-criteria ID cross-reference scheme established linking each User Story's Acceptance Scenarios to their corresponding FR/SC numbers, to make traceability auditable? [Traceability, Gap]
